dior-sauvage.name: Sauvage

music.title: original score
music.note: original composition by Ry Cooder; La Reclame says performed by Johnny Depp on guitar

campaigns.setting: leaves Los Angeles by car for the desert around Joshua Tree, California

dior-sauvage.remarks: Depp has fronted Sauvage since the 2015 relaunch, every film by Mondino. The 2019 'We Are the Land' teaser was pulled after accusations of cultural appropriation of Native American imagery. Eau Sauvage (Alain Delon, Black Strobe 'I'm a Man') is a different fragrance, do not mix up.

dior-jadore.name: J'adore

campaigns.setting: Hall of Mirrors, Palace of Versailles; first aired on TF1 on 4 September 2011

music.title: Hey Now
music.note: J'adore Dior remix by The Shoes

campaigns.setting: Palace of Versailles; gown by Maria Grazia Chiuri

dior-jadore.remarks: Theron was the face from 2004 to 2024 (about 20 years). La Reclame also lists a 2011 'striptease' spot on Marvin Gaye 'A Funky Space Reincarnation' and a 2016 Mondino film on Woodkid 'I Love You' (single source each, not recorded as campaigns). Rihanna (first Black face of J'adore) announced June 2024, film released 11 Sept 2024.

dior-miss-dior.name: Miss Dior

campaigns.setting: runaway bride on her wedding day

campaigns.title: What would you do for love?
campaigns.setting: shot in Paris and Los Angeles

music.title: Cry Baby
music.note: Joplin's cover of the Garnet Mimms song

campaigns.setting: streets of Paris; wardrobe by Jonathan Anderson

dior-miss-dior.remarks: Portman is Dior beauty ambassador since 2011; 2026 is her eighth Miss Dior campaign (relaunch of the Eau de Parfum, 6 Aug 2026). Sources disagree on the music of the Sofia Coppola film(s) (Gainsbourg/Birkin 'Je t'aime moi non plus' vs 'La vie en rose'), so music left empty. Year of the 'Cry Baby' film given as 2021 by Auralcrave; not confirmed by a brand source.

dior-dior-homme.name: Dior Homme

campaigns.setting: black and white; elevator, bed and underwater scenes

dior-dior-homme.remarks: Facts thin for the 2025 Parfum film: no director or music credit found in clean sources. Hypebae (2025) also links the Cohen/The Blaze remix to Dior Homme coverage; the year attribution between 2020 and 2025 is not fully reconciled.

dior-hypnotic-poison.name: Hypnotic Poison

music.title: I Put a Spell on You

campaigns.setting: Louvre museum, privatised for the shoot; first aired on TF1 on Sunday 3 October

dior-hypnotic-poison.remarks: Thin. Only the Mélanie Laurent / John Cameron Mitchell film is well documented (first TF1 airing 3 October, which points to 2010; some outlets say 2011). Monica Bellucci and Milla Jovovich are cited as earlier faces but no film credits found in clean sources.

chanel-n-5.remarks: Earlier icons cited by press: Marilyn Monroe (radio quote, not a film), Catherine Deneuve, Carole Bouquet (1986 Ridley Scott 'Monuments'). The 2012 Brad Pitt film had no song recorded in sources found.

chanel-coco-mademoiselle.name: Coco Mademoiselle

music.title: It's a Man's Man's Man's World

campaigns.setting: Paris, motorcycle ride to a photo shoot

chanel-coco-mademoiselle.remarks: Knightley was the face from about 2007 (some say 2006) until 2023. Director of the 2023 Whitney Peak film not found.

chanel-bleu-de-chanel.remarks: Chalamet named ambassador May 2023. 2017 Ulliel film is single-source (La Reclame). Ulliel died in January 2022.

fairground; four young women for the four Chance fragrances

chanel-chance.remarks: 2024 music conflicting (Ibeyi per Journal du Luxe, original by Raphael Beau per Paris Select Book), so not recorded. Strong French angle: Angèle 2025.

chanel-allure-homme-sport.remarks: Thin on music. Surfer name spelled Ben or Danny Fuller depending on outlet.

lancome-la-vie-est-belle.name: La Vie est Belle
lancome-la-vie-est-belle.remarks: Roberts has fronted the line since launch in 2012. A 2025 'Lancome Express' film by Chazelle (Piaf 'Non, je ne regrette rien') is a brand film with several ambassadors, not strictly La Vie est Belle. Other directors cited in passing: Bruno Aveillan.

lancome-idole.name: Idôle

lancome-idole.remarks: Thin after 2023: no 2024-2026 Idôle film found.

lancome-tresor.name: Trésor

campaigns.setting: tribute to Godard's 'A bout de souffle' (Nouvelle Vague)

lancome-tresor.remarks: La Nuit Trésor is a flanker; La Nuit Trésor Intense 2022 used 'Women in Power' (Philippe Briand & Gabriel Saban). Original 1990 Isabella Rossellini era: no clean film credits found. Music for 2013 spot conflicting.

Libre Freedom

yves-saint-laurent-libre.remarks: Hypebae spells director 'Diane Kunst'. Libre Santal Couture 2026 film by Romain Wygas in a South African desert (Hypebae, single source).

yves-saint-laurent-black-opium.remarks: 2014 launch film with Edie Campbell: no director credit found. Nuit Blanche year not in sources (around 2016). Current face 2026: Alisha Boe.

yves-saint-laurent-y.name: Y

music.title: Are You Gonna Go My Way
Are You Gonna Go My Way

yves-saint-laurent-y.remarks: Austin Butler fronts MYSLF (a different YSL men's scent), not Y. Director of 2022 and 2024 films not found.

yves-saint-laurent-mon-paris.name: Mon Paris
yves-saint-laurent-mon-paris.remarks: Thin after 2020: no 2022-2026 Mon Paris film or face confirmed by clean sources. Actor name spelled Crista Corber in Media Marketing.

giorgio-armani-my-way.name: My Way
giorgio-armani-my-way.remarks: Thin: no post-2022 My Way film found.

valentino-donna-born-in-roma.name: Donna Born in Roma
valentino-donna-born-in-roma.remarks: Shared campaign with Uomo Born in Roma (same film). 2026: Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgard named faces of a new Valentino fragrance era (no film details found).

valentino-uomo-born-in-roma.name: Uomo Born in Roma
valentino-uomo-born-in-roma.remarks: Thin; same campaigns as Donna. No separate men-only film found.

guerlain-shalimar.name: Shalimar

campaigns.title: La Légende de Shalimar
campaigns.setting: shot in India; Vodianova plays Mumtaz Mahal; first aired on TF1; costumes Yiqing Yin

guerlain-shalimar.remarks: No Shalimar film after 2014 found. 'Initial' (2011) is a flanker, also on Gainsbourg 'Initiales BB'.

guerlain-mon-guerlain.name: Mon Guerlain

campaigns.title: Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense

guerlain-mon-guerlain.remarks: Jolie fee reportedly donated to charity. No newer film confirmed (2024 items look like reposts).

paco-rabanne-1-million.name: 1 Million

campaigns.title: Million Nation (shared 1 Million / Lady Million film)

paco-rabanne-1-million.remarks: Director of the 2019 film conflicts: BuzzWebzine names Oliver Hadlee Pearch, too-young.com names Paul Gore (Standard/Iconoclast); left blank. The finger snap is the recurring signature of the 1 Million / Lady Million films. No reliable credits found for the 2008 launch film or a 2021-2026 1 Million film. Million Gold For Her (2024, Gigi Hadid, 'Pure/Honey' by Beyonce) is a separate women's line, recorded under Lady Million as related context.

paco-rabanne-invictus.name: Invictus

campaigns.setting: Stadium; athletes worshipped as modern gods, mythology references

music.title: We Are the Champions
music.note: La Reclame calls it a reinterpretation of the Queen song

paco-rabanne-invictus.remarks: Current campaign (2026) director not found. Kanye West 'POWER' is the music most associated with Invictus in France.

paco-rabanne-lady-million.name: Lady Million
paco-rabanne-lady-million.remarks: 2024 entry is Million Gold For Her, the successor women's line, not Lady Million itself; include as context. Lady Million films share the finger-snap signature with 1 Million.

paco-rabanne-phantom.name: Phantom

campaigns.setting: Retro-futuristic 'Paco Galaxy', Palm Springs-like setting; robot-shaped bottle

paco-rabanne-phantom.remarks: 2021 production company Partizan, VFX The Mill Paris (The Mill). 2023 production company Division per The Mill.

paco-rabanne-fame.name: Fame
paco-rabanne-fame.remarks: Thin: director not confirmed (one magazine names Solal Micenmacher for visuals, not recorded). Only one film campaign found; later Fame flanker films reuse Elle Fanning.

jean-paul-gaultier-le-male.name: Le Male

jean-paul-gaultier-le-male.remarks: Year of first Mondino film is not firmly dated by sources (the fragrance launched 1995; Mondino 'helmed' the early joint Le Male/Classique films). On the Docks dated 2013 by trade press, 2016 by Adland. 'Casta Diva' is constant across campaigns.

jean-paul-gaultier-scandal.name: Scandal
jean-paul-gaultier-scandal.remarks: 2021 entry is the men's flanker Scandal pour Homme; 2025 is Scandal Intense.

jean-paul-gaultier-la-belle.name: La Belle
jean-paul-gaultier-la-belle.remarks: THIN: no reliable source found for the face, director or music of the La Belle films. Only the Eden / La Belle and Le Beau concept is documented. Needs manual check on the official JPG YouTube channel.

jean-paul-gaultier-classique.remarks: Classique shares its films with Le Male (sailor + corseted woman). 1993 launch film not documented; 1995 is the start of the joint Mondino films (approximate).

thierry-mugler-alien.name: Alien
thierry-mugler-alien.remarks: Sigismondi film year from a 2014 OSMOZ article (approximate). Production for Sigismondi film: Believe Media.

campaigns.setting: Top of a New York skyscraper

dolce-gabbana-light-blue.name: Light Blue
dolce-gabbana-light-blue.remarks: Year of first Testino film approximate (Testino shot the original Capri campaign from 2006/2007; launch was 2001). Cinematographer John Mathieson on Testino films. Music for Light Blue films not found in clean sources.

hugo-boss-boss-alive.name: Boss Alive
hugo-boss-boss-alive.remarks: Aired 2020 and again 2021 in France. No later Boss Alive film found. 'musique pub parfum alive' = 'What's Up' by 4 Non Blondes.

montblanc-legend.name: Legend
montblanc-legend.remarks: 2011 launch film not documented. Zidane 2022 director/music not found.

prada-paradoxe.name: Paradoxe
prada-paradoxe.remarks: Watson's directorial debut. Creative directors Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons. No later Paradoxe film credits found.

prada-luna-rossa-carbon.name: Luna Rossa Carbon
